args.notes: Spec: 16-axis motor control, 32 simultaneous requests per 1us tick, all 32 results back within 0.44us p99. Batch throughput is the binding constraint: pipelined families with enough parallelism (m) are likely needed; unrolled_k with k>=32 may be too area-heavy. Keep accuracy >= 12 bits (max_abs_err <= 2^-12). Minimize luts+ffs.
